opus.problem: The best-known Timothy material is missing. There is nothing on Paul urging him not to let anyone look down on him for being young, nor on Paul calling him his true or beloved son in the faith. Smaller details are used instead, such as his release in Hebrews and the Corinthians being told not to make him afraid. One of those could be swapped for a youth or 'son in the faith' clue.
